subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to fill in the blanks. 

The villagers brought the little boy to the ________, who examined him closely, spotted a mole on his left _______, and solemnly declared him the chosen one.
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. oracle, auricle .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **oracle** refers to a person or entity that provides wise or prophetic predictions, often associated with divine or supernatural knowledge. In the context of the sentence, the villagers brought the boy to an oracle.
 
• The word **auricle** refers to the external part of the ear (or pinna). It fits the sentence, as the boy is being examined closely, and the mole is spotted on his left auricle.
 
• The other options are incorrect because they either repeat the same word twice (e.g., "oracle, oracle" or "auricle, auricle") or mix them incorrectly.

Correct sentence: *The villagers brought the little boy to the **oracle**, who examined him closely, spotted a mole on his left **auricle**, and solemnly declared him the chosen one*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Oracle:**
 
 
• **Definition:** A person or medium through whom advice or prophecy is sought.
 
• **Usage:** Refers to someone who provides wisdom or divine predictions.
 
• **Example:** The oracle foretold the coming of a great leader.
 
 
 
• **Auricle:**
 
 
• **Definition:** The external part of the ear.
 
• **Usage:** Often used in medical or anatomical contexts.
 
• **Example:** The doctor examined the auricle for signs of infection.
